htmx script tag.description: Load htmx 2 from the jsDelivr CDN

hx-get element.description: Element that GETs a URL and swaps the response into a target

hx-post form.description: Form submitted with hx-post, response swapped into a target

hx-delete button.description: Delete button with confirmation that removes the closest row
hx-delete button.body: <button hx-delete="${1:/items/1}" hx-confirm="${2:Are you sure?}" hx-target="${3:closest tr}" hx-swap="${4:outerHTML swap:500ms}">${5:Delete}</button>

hx-put element.description: Element that sends a PUT request

hx-patch element.description: Element that sends a PATCH request

Active search.description: Search input that queries as you type, debounced

Infinite scroll.description: Last item loads the next page when it scrolls into view

Load on page load.description: Lazy-load content once the element is loaded

Click to edit.description: Button that swaps its container for an edit form

Boosted links.description: Turn regular links and forms inside into AJAX requests

Out-of-band swap.description: Response fragment swapped into an element by id, outside the main target

Loading indicator.description: Element shown while a request is in flight

hx-vals.description: Extra values to send with the request

hx-headers.description: Extra headers to send with the request

Request lifecycle listener.description: Inline handler for an htmx event
